messages.text: Proposal: automate verified customer refunds. The service will calculate the standard refund amount, confirm the customer identity check is complete, and send approved refunds to our payment provider without another manual handoff.
Finance approves this workflow for verified refund requests. Calculation uses the standard method, identity verification remains required, and execution may be automatic.
Decision status: APPROVED. Owner: Finance Operations. Effective July 1, 2026. Related engineering ticket: PAY-104.

normalized_decision.title: Verified refunds may be processed automatically
